none: PAS FindID 1014277: Roman coin: denarius of Vespasian, chipped
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver coin. Denarius of Vespasian (69-79) with retrograde legend; chipped with loss of over one third of flan. Obverse description: craggy bull-necked bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [--]VESPASIANVS AVG. Reverse description: draped figure seated left; illegible trace of inscription. Diameter: 19.2mm, Weight: 1.95gms, die axis: 6
